stories.title: Alice Huang, Accused of Spying on Nvidia’s CEO, Is Linked to Firms With Ties to China’s Military
stories.summary: Alice Huang, who is accused of spying on Nvidia's CEO, is reportedly connected to a group of Chinese technology and defense companies. These firms are said to require advanced computing capabilities, suggesting a potential link between the alleged espionage and China's military-industrial complex.

stories.title: Govt Warns Hackers Are Exploiting Payment And Business Systems: Is Your Money At Risk?
stories.summary: A cybersecurity warning has been issued regarding hackers exploiting payment and business systems, raising concerns about financial security. The alert highlights new threats from AI-powered hacking tools, unauthorized payment transactions, and risks to data security within business payment workflows.

stories.title: The FBI was hacked again, this time the breach targeted its crime database
stories.summary: The FBI's crime database was reportedly compromised in a recent hacking incident.

stories.title: This Player Uses His Brain To Play GTA 6, Not A Controller: How Neuralink Makes It Possible
stories.summary: A participant in a Neuralink clinical trial has demonstrated playing a video game using only brain signals, without a traditional controller. This showcases how Elon Musk's brain-computer interface technology allows direct interaction with digital systems through thought.

stories.title: India ranks second to the US for share of companies expanding tech teams to support AI growth, study find
stories.summary: A study indicates that India is second only to the United States in the proportion of companies expanding their technology teams to support the growth of artificial intelligence.

stories.title: Anthropic’s Debut Shows the Disconnect Between Wall Street and Silicon Valley
stories.summary: Anthropic, a major artificial intelligence company, had a record-breaking initial public offering this week. However, its first full day of trading was difficult as market concerns about AI spending led to a plunge in stock values.

stories.title: Nvidia Said to Face S.E.C. Probe Into Its Accounting Practices
stories.summary: Nvidia is reportedly under investigation by the S.E.C. regarding its accounting practices. This inquiry follows earlier concerns about the company's chip sales in Asia.

stories.title: AI woes batters Wall Street; S&P 500 enters correction, Nasdaq turns negative for year
stories.summary: Wall Street experienced a significant sell-off, particularly in technology and AI stocks, leading the S&P 500 into a correction and the Nasdaq turning negative for the year. Investor worries about AI valuations caused chipmakers to decline substantially, while government bonds rallied as investors moved to safer assets.

stories.title: RBI To Meet NBFCs On November 23: Microfinance Stress, Gold Loans And Cybersecurity Risks On Agenda
stories.summary: The RBI will meet with NBFCs on November 23 to discuss important issues. The agenda includes stress in the microfinance sector, risks associated with gold loans, and cybersecurity concerns.

stories.title: Tata Group Row: Noel Tata Questions Chandrasekaran's Reappointment, Seeks Replies From Tata Sons Board By November 25
stories.summary: Noel Tata has questioned the reappointment of N Chandrasekaran and other significant decisions made by Tata Sons. He has requested detailed answers from the board by November 25, before their next scheduled meeting.

stories.title: Takeaways From Trump’s Post-Trip News Conference
stories.summary: President Trump described his trilateral meeting with Xi Jinping and Vladimir Putin in China as a significant event. He also indicated a willingness to collaborate with Democrats in Congress on important matters.

stories.title: US court sentences Nikhil Gupta to nearly 20 years for plot to kill Pannun
stories.summary: A US court has sentenced Nikhil Gupta to nearly 20 years in prison for his involvement in a plot to kill Pannun.

stories.title: 'Voices carry no weight': Wangchuk warns Ladakh's alienation could hurt national security during war
stories.summary: Wangchuk has issued a warning that if Ladakh feels alienated, it could negatively impact national security during a time of war.

stories.title: ‘LOOK AT INDIA’: Angry Trump Cites India’s 7% GDP Growth, BLASTS US Fed Over ‘High Interest Rates’
stories.summary: Donald Trump criticized the US Federal Reserve for its high interest rates, pointing to India's 7% GDP growth as a contrast.

stories.title: 'Will find way forward through dialogue': Amit Shah assures Arunachal locals amid Siang dam protests
stories.summary: Amit Shah has assured residents of Arunachal Pradesh that a solution will be found through dialogue regarding the protests against the Siang dam.

stories.title: US court strikes down fixed stay rule for international students, exchange visitors
stories.summary: A US court has invalidated a rule that imposed a fixed duration of stay for international students and exchange visitors. This decision means that these individuals will no longer be subject to a predetermined time limit for their stay in the country.

stories.title: H-1B workers’ children could get US Green Cards under proposed immigration Bill
stories.summary: A new immigration bill has been proposed that could allow children of H-1B visa holders to receive US Green Cards. This legislation aims to provide a path to permanent residency for these children.

stories.title: Texas governor-elect Hinojosa plans to lift H-1B freeze at state agencies, universities
stories.summary: The governor-elect of Texas, Hinojosa, intends to end the freeze on H-1B visas at state agencies and universities. This action would allow these institutions to once again sponsor foreign employees for H-1B visas.

stories.title: U.S. H-1B visa issuances drop by approximately one-third year-on-year as companies such as IBM reduce sponsorship for foreign employees
stories.summary: The number of H-1B visas issued by the U.S. has decreased by about one-third compared to the previous year. This decline is occurring as some companies, including IBM, are reducing their sponsorship of foreign employees.

stories.title: International Student Enrollment Plunged. Schools Are Bracing for More Losses.
stories.summary: International student enrollment has significantly decreased, and educational institutions are preparing for further reductions. This trend indicates a challenging period for schools that rely on international students.
